acceptanceCriteria: With opt-in policy `pools[].priorityAdmission: true`, an explicit `claim --ticket X --pool P` is refused (BLOCKED, `RESOURCE_COLLISION`, detail naming the yielded-to ticket) when free eligible members of P are no more than the number of OPEN, claim-eligible, higher-priority tickets with `requiresPool == P` and no live attempt. Ordering is (priority, order, ticketId), the same as planLess.
With the flag absent or false, claim bytes and receipts are identical to today (N-1 replay test).
`plan preview --pool P` and `claim-next` produce the same decision as the explicit claim for the same snapshot (a property test over generated pool/ticket states).

body: Filed 2026-10-05 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#583 (orchestrator triage T583a, read-only code survey on origin/main 019f958a; findings are code-read inferences, not runtime). - Type FEATURE, **P1**: an hour-long critical-path stall, and the caller-side workaround races. The work is small and pure-planner. - Labels: `agent-memory`, `ideas`, `github583` - touchPaths: `.corvint/change.cem.json`, `.corvint/changes/`, `docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md`, `docs/specs/INDEX.json`, `docs/specs/README.md`, `docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md`, `internal/tasks/cli/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/lease_claim.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/pool_priority_test.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/pools.go` - Acceptance: 1. With opt-in policy `pools[].priorityAdmission: true`, an explicit `claim --ticket X --pool P` is refused (BLOCKED, `RESOURCE_COLLISION`, detail naming the yielded-to ticket) when free eligible members of P are no more than the number of OPEN, claim-eligible, higher-priority tickets with `requiresPool == P` and no live attempt. Ordering is (priority, order, ticketId), the same as planLess. 2. With the flag absent or false, claim bytes and receipts are identical to today (N-1 replay test). 3. `plan preview --pool P` and `claim-next` produce the same decision as the explicit claim for the same snapshot (a property test over generated pool/ticket states). 4. The read stays pure: plan preview writes nothing and runs no probes (CAL-V0-034). When `requiresPool` on a competing ticket is not observable, the claim is not refused on its account, and the read reports the gap as NOT_OBSERVED. - Depends on: V1-0754/0758 for real-world effect (tickets must carry `requiresPool`).

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: opt-in priorityAdmission yield, identical bytes with the flag absent, plan/claim-next/claim parity, pure read with NOT_OBSERVED gaps.
